title: Contributions in Aid of Construction and Refundable Advances on Line Extensions and New Service Construction
content:
The contribution a member pays toward a **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** project is booked by Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative in one of two classes, fixed by the class of extension:

- **Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction** — the contribution is the member's payment toward the line and carries no refund.
- **Refundable advance** — the contribution is an advance, part of which stays subject to refund as other members connect to the extension.

## Contribution class and refund terms by class of extension

| Class of extension | Contribution class | Refund period after energization | Refund basis | Largest share of the advance that can be refunded | Month in which refunds earned in the prior year are paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction | 0 months | None | 0% | 1 (January) |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction | 0 months | None | 0% | 1 (January) |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction | 0 months | None | 0% | 1 (January) |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction | 0 months | None | 0% | 1 (January) |
| Irrigation Well Extension | Refundable advance | 60 months | Allowance of the connecting member | 100% | 1 (January) |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | Refundable advance | 60 months | Allowance of the connecting member | 100% | 1 (January) |
| Temporary Construction Service | Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction | 0 months | None | 0% | 1 (January) |

## Terms explained

- **Refund period** — the months after energization during which refunds are made on a refundable advance: 60 months, that is five years, on the two refundable classes; 0 on the others.
- **Refund basis "allowance of the connecting member"** — each new permanent member who connects to the extension earns a refund equal to that connecting member's own allowance. "None" means no refunds apply.
- **Largest share refundable** — on the two refundable classes, refunds may reach 100 percent of the advance and no more; on the others the figure is 0 percent.
- **Payment month** — calendar month 1, January, is the month in which refunds earned in the prior year are paid. The month is shown for every class, but only the refundable classes earn refunds.

## Side by side

| | Nonrefundable contribution in aid of construction | Refundable advance |
|---|---|---|
| Classes | Permanent Residential Overhead, Permanent Residential Underground, Seasonal Residence, Farm and Ranch, Temporary Construction Service | Irrigation Well, Three-Phase Commercial |
| Refund period | 0 months | 60 months |
| Refund basis | None | Allowance of the connecting member |
| Refund ceiling | 0% | 100% of the advance |
